title: The Diggers
summary: The Redhand you drove out of the Tithe Mill went to Wickham Keep, under a Captain Garrow. Osric Hale has heard they are digging in its cellars. Bandits don't dig, so somebody must be paying them to.

steps.journal: Go to Wickham Keep, on the Wickham road north of the crossroads, and take the stairs down to its second floor.

objectives.label: Down to the Keep's second floor

steps.journal: Captain Garrow waits in the stair hall of the Keep's second floor (the room with the stairs down). Defeat him; his men come when he shouts.

ready: Go back to Osric Hale at the Watch post by Thornwick's well. Garrow kept a ledger; Osric will want it.
done: You defeated Captain Garrow in Wickham Keep. His ledger says robed strangers paid him to dig at the Sunken Chapel.
